payload.caption: Overhead view of an enclosed facility with a distinctive circular multi-lobed driveway layout, surrounded by dense urban development.
payload.description: High-resolution overhead optical imagery showing an open rectangular/trapezoidal ground plot situated within a dense urban street grid. The central portion of the plot features a prominent circular ground structure composed of paved loops and rounded driveways radiating in a multi-lobed arrangement around a central point. South of this circular pattern are several low-rise rectangular buildings, paved courtyards, and small structures. A diagonal feature (road, embankment, or rail track) borders the upper right side of the open lot. The surrounding area consists of multi-lane city streets, multi-story residential building complexes, construction sites, and a sports track visible to the west.
